title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Critique in Researcher, with Claude reviewing GPT drafts
summary: Hold: Microsoft has described Critique as the default Researcher experience when Auto is selected, contrary to the briefing's claim that its default is unstated. Microsoft Learn also describes Critique as live in Frontier; the briefing must distinguish that availability from the roadmap's December general availability target.

claims.claim: Microsoft's subprocessor page currently excludes Claude models in Researcher from the EU Data Boundary and applicable in-country processing commitments.

claims.claim: The Researcher FAQ says Researcher adheres to the EU and Microsoft 365 boundaries.

claims.claim: The general subprocessor setting defaults to No users in the EU, EFTA and UK.
claims.quote: the default is set to No users. These regions include the European Union (EU), the European Free Trade Association (EFTA), and the United Kingdom (UK).
